reviews.title: Cheap but quality cooler
reviews.comment: Easy to install and daisy chain with my other RGB fans. I was on the stock ryzen cooler but I upgraded to the 3700X I kept overheating errors while gaming. No more errors and the idle temp is about 40 degrees Celsius under load around 75 to 80 degrees Celsius very usable might even get a decent overlock with it with a decent under voltage. For this price this is amazing for sure!

reviews.comment: The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/D1Umm0SeS6L.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/71rrHPU30aL._SY256.jpg I've built two PCs with this cooler. reviews.title: Low Cost Cooler, High Value Proposition
reviews.comment:
An air cooler that can handle the heat without it's size blocking any RAM slots. The mounting/installation of the cooler was fast, though the tension of the springs for the screws was a bit tight and required a little bit of adjustment before and after attempting to install, but is par for the course on air coolers in general. For the price, you can't beat the value. It was keeping the i7-6700k I installed it on very cool for every benchmark I ran for it, and it was very quiet.
I am unsure about the reliability of the fans, as they are their own re-branded fans, but they are smooth, nearly silent, and I will update if it has any problems in the near future!
reviews.author: Brandon Dysart
